subject: Post-call: Q3 usage review & growth plan for Orbit Analytics
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Anya Petrov <anya@orbitanalytics.com>, Ben Holt <ben.holt@orbitanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Q3 usage review & growth plan for Orbit Analytics

Hi Anya / Ben —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have aligned next steps. I pulled the notes from the call below and attached the usage export you promised.

Key pain points we heard
- Large daily traffic spikes (batch jobs at 02:00 UTC) causing 95/99 p99 latency spikes and token-cost volatility.
- Current embeddings usage for search is expensive and under-optimized (many short queries, repeated prefixes).
- New workload: document classification pipeline that will run ~2M docs/month starting Nov — needs predictable latency and data-residency controls.

Business goals
- Reduce inference spend by ~30% while holding 99th percentile latency <= 350ms for interactive endpoints.
- Bring the new classification workload online in Nov with predictable monthly costs.
- Ensure customer data stays within US region and that we can support VPC/private deployment for sensitive datasets.

Proposed approach (high level)
1) Technical: run a short (2-week) pilot on Dedicated capacity with workload-specific batching + prefix caching for embeddings. We'll configure a quantized model variant for classification to lower token costs.
2) Security/ops: provide SOC 2 + architecture notes and confirm VPC option for production.
3) Commercial: draft a 3-month pilot quote that covers reserved capacity for the pilot window and an uplift path for full production.

Attachments: Orbit-Q3-usage.csv (attached) and Redwood-Recommended-Config.pdf (attached). I also pushed a short playbook to our internal docs (link below).

Next steps / owners
- Anya/Ben: confirm the sample dataset for the classification pilot (you mentioned a daily export) — ACTION: share S3 path or drop CSV by Fri 10/2.
- Jonas (me): ship pilot config + cost estimate by Tue 10/6.
- Marissa: prepare SOC2 pack and customer references; confirm availability for an engineering demo week of Oct 6–9.

Proposed times for a technical deep-dive demo: Oct 6 10:00–11:00 PT or Oct 8 14:00–15:00 PT. Which works best for your eng leads?

Thanks again — excited to help Orbit reduce spend while standing up the classification workload.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0121

From: Anya Petrov <anya@orbitanalytics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Holt <ben.holt@orbitanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Q3 usage review & growth plan for Orbit Analytics

Jonas — thanks for the thorough write-up. Quick clarifications and a couple asks from our side:

Confirmations
- We'll upload the sample export by EOD Fri 10/2 to the S3 path I shared in the call (s3://orbit-analytics/exports/redwood-sample). That will include ~30k docs (~200MB) for classification testing.
- We want the pilot to demonstrate the cost delta for embeddings vs. current setup and validate the classification latency under peak.

Additional constraints
- Data residency: production must remain in US-East; we are open to a Private/VPC deployment for the classification dataset.
- Compliance: please include SOC 2 Type II evidence and network architecture diagram in the pack.

Timeline & procurement
- Procurement: we need a draft quote and SOW by Oct 9 to get approvals for a Nov pilot start.
- Headcount: we have two ML engineers (Sam and Lina) who will attend the technical demo. Can you include them on invites?

We can do Oct 6 10:00 PT for the engineering session. Please send calendar invite and attach any pre-reads (config + expected metrics) so Sam/Lina can review.

Thanks,
Anya
Head of Product Integrations | Orbit Analytics
anya@orbitanalytics.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Orbit pilot: internal next steps + materials to prep

Marissa / Rachel —

Anya confirmed the S3 path and wants a SOC 2 pack + VPC option included in the pilot SOW. They picked Oct 6 10:00 PT for the engineering demo (Sam, Lina attending).

Quick checklist I captured from the thread (owner / ETA):
- Marissa: SOC 2 Type II evidence + network architecture diagram (attach to SOW) — ETA Mon 10/5 EOD.
- Rachel: pilot commercial (redwood-quote-v2.pdf) + 2-week Dedicated pricing with uplift path to production. Include a line-item for private VPC set-up fees. ETA Mon 10/5.
- Jonas: finalize pilot config (batching, cache TTLs, quantized model suggestion) and pre-read slides for the demo. I'll include Redwood-Recommended-Config.pdf and the Orbit-Q3-usage.csv in the invite. ETA Tue 10/6 morning.

I'll create the calendar invite and attach the pre-reads. Marissa—please include two short customer references that can speak to migration timelines (preferably those with VPC deployments).

Notes: procurement needs draft SOW/quote by Oct 9 — we should priority this for the commercial pack.

Thanks — will follow up after I send the invite.

Best,
Jonas
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
